data.raw_text:
GCV Community Education Series #20

From Vision to Economy: The Engine of GCV Before Fully OM

Dear Global Pioneers,
Respected GCV Leaders,
Merchants, Ambassadors, and Friends Around the World,
Today, I want to speak clearly about economy, market rules, and why partial Pi payments at GCV are the engine of Pi Network before fully Open Mainnet.
And I also want to express my deep gratitude — because what we are witnessing now is historic.

1️⃣ What Is Economy?
Economy is not price.
Economy is not speculation.
Economy is not waiting for exchanges.
Economy is production, exchange, and circulation of value.
If there is no circulation, there is no economy.
Currency is only a tool.
Circulation is the life.
If Pi does not circulate, it remains potential.
When Pi circulates, it becomes economy.

2️⃣ What Are Market Rules?
Market rules are universal.
The market runs on:
Mutual benefit
Incentives
Supply and demand
First-mover advantage
Visibility creates traffic
Traffic creates revenue
The market does not run on emotions.
It runs on benefits.
If participation creates benefit, people join.
If it does not, people leave.
Very simple.

3️⃣ Why I Advocate Partial Pi Payments at GCV Before Fully OM
Some pioneers say:
“Let us wait for fully OM.”
But waiting is not economic behavior.
Partial Pi payment means:
Part fiat
Part Pi at GCV
Real goods
Real services
Real transactions
This creates real circulation.
Value is not announced.
Value is practiced.
When pioneers use Pi in partial payments, we create:
Demand
Confidence
Merchant incentive
Real use cases
This is how economy begins.
Before fully OM, we build internal strength.
We activate the engine.

Partial Pi payment GCV is a step toward full Pi GCV. This is only a stage, not our destination. Partial Pi payment GCV is the bridge to help us reach full Pi payment, and it can make liquidity from Pi to FIAT happen safely and sustainably. I know many pioneers don't want this process but want Pi to FIAT right now. This is like building a 3-story house but not wanting the first floor. It will collapse if there is no first floor. What we do now is to make the 3rd floor strong.

4️⃣ Why GCV Education Is Critical
Without education, pioneers only ask:
“When can I cash out?”
But currency is not designed only to be sold.
Currency is designed to circulate.
If everyone waits to sell, who will buy?
If everyone waits for external validation, who builds internal value?
GCV education transforms mindset:
From holders
to builders.
From spectators
to participants.
That mindset is the foundation of long-term success.

5️⃣ Why Partial Pi Payment Is the Engine
We have tens of millions of pioneers worldwide.
If even a small percentage:
Buy coffee
Use services
Shop with partial Pi
We instantly create:
Market demand
Merchant incentive
Social proof
Economic activity
This becomes a self-sustaining engine.
Not theory.
Not dream.
Real circulation.
And circulation creates confidence.
Confidence attracts more participation.
This is market law.

6️⃣ Why Businesses Will Not Reject This Model
Let us think like business owners.
Every business has one major headache:
Advertising cost.
Advertising is expensive.
Small businesses suffer the most.
Even when they can afford ads, there is no guarantee of customers.
Now imagine:
They accept partial Pi payment at GCV.
They enter a global community.
Their brand is seen by pioneers worldwide.
Early adopters gain first-mover advantage.
At early stage:
High visibility
Less competition
Strong positioning
Why would a smart entrepreneur reject that?
They won’t.
Because this follows market rules.
Mutual benefit.

7️⃣ From Community Movement to Real Business World
And today, I am very happy.
Because our GCV movement has transformed.
It is no longer only a community movement.
It is entering the real business world.
We are seeing:
Professional merchant advertisements
Real transaction models
Strategic promotion
Business mindset
This is maturity.
This is evolution.
This is economic structure forming.

8️⃣ Global Contribution and Leadership
Of course, we have amazing merchants and pioneers in:
Thailand
Vietnam
Philippines
Indonesia
Malaysia
Cameroon
Ivory Coast
Benin
Bangladesh
Arab regions
and other countries maybe I didn't mention
All contributing strongly.

And I am especially happy to see India merchants.
In only one year, they moved with passion and professionalism.
They understand advertisement logic.
They understand market timing.
They act fast.
This is economic intelligence.

Thanks to the exceptional leadership and dedication of India Head of GCV Ambassador Mr. Raaj Shama and Global GCV Community India Partner Mr. Issack Bester, together with all India GCV Ambassadors, GCV Special Envoys, GCV Community leaders, merchants, and pioneers for their contributions.

9️⃣ Gratitude to Our Global Leaders
I sincerely thank:
International GCV Industry Alliance Chair
Ms. Lumari
Vice Chair
Mr. Jojo
GCV Community Alliance Diplomat
Ms. Nonny Padja
great leadership and hardworking.
And all Global GCV Ambassadors and Special Envoys
for your hardworking and extraordinary dedication to Pi Network’s long-term vision.
You are building bridges between:
Community and industry
Vision and practice
Consensus and circulation
This is leadership.
This is responsibility.
This is history in progress.

🔟 Final Message
I do not advocate partial Pi payment emotionally.
I advocate it based on:
Economic principles.
Market rules.
Incentive structures.
First-mover advantage.
Real business logic.
If we want Pi Network to succeed,
We must behave like an economy.
Not like spectators.
Do not wait for the engine.
Be the engine.
Circulation creates value.
Participation creates economy.
Economy creates strength.
And strength builds the future.
Thank you.
Let us continue with confidence, unity, and professionalism.
The real business world has already begun.

Doris Yin 🪷🪷🪷
Founder, Global GCV Movement
Feb. 10th 2026
